message.content: Keysight Technologies Inc reported third quarter revenue of 1846000000.00 and GAAP net income of 397000000.00, representing growth on a year earlier of 0.365385 for revenue and 1.078534 for net income [D1]. The company delivered non-GAAP earnings per share of 3.07, which exceeded the analyst consensus, while orders surged 56% to 2091000000.00 driven by AI infrastructure demand particularly in wireline where revenue surpassed wireless for the first time [D2]. Management raised its outlook for the fourth fiscal quarter of 2026 to a revenue range of 1930000000.00 to 1950000000.00 with non-GAAP earnings per share expected between 3.34 and 3.40, significantly above Wall Street forecasts [D3]. The stock closed at 333.42 trading in an uptrend with a trailing price to earnings ratio of 45.8862 and immediate resistance edges at 366.41 while support is found at 332.78 and 300.87 [D1]. Analysts project a mean price target of 418.42 indicating potential upside, though management cautioned that supply chain constraints will act as a governor on near-term revenue conversion for the next several quarters [D4]. The company ended the quarter with cash, cash equivalents, and restricted cash totaling 2622000000.00 and shareholders equity of 6571000000.00 against total assets of 11921000000.00 [D1]. Management plans to realize 80% to 90% of the 100000000.00 in cost synergies on a run rate basis exiting the fiscal year as integration efforts are largely complete [D3]. The company will participate in upcoming investor conferences including the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on September 11, 2026 and the Truist Technology Symposium on September 15, 2026 [D6]. Keysight also announced a research collaboration with the Centre for Assuring Autonomy at the University of York to advance AI safety assurance for software-defined vehicles [D7].
